prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity dark desktop portfolio landing-page direction comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design an unmistakably non-generic responsive website viewport for COLTON SPURGIN as an indoor-weather hall: one vast artificial sun reveals the different lives and bodies of work gathered beneath it. The visitor must quickly understand who Colton is, what he has done, and whether his working style fits them.
Scene/backdrop: a flat front-facing website screenshot whose interface is one immense dark horizontal hall, not a photograph inside a normal webpage
Subject: a candid portfolio for an Air Force NCO, lead software developer intern, research assistant, and UWF senior specializing in AI graduating December 2026, who wants to build useful ambitious software and pursue a master’s degree
Style/medium: high-fidelity dark web UI fused with monofrequency sodium light, haze, silhouette, and a mirrored ceiling; cinematic but precise, quiet confidence, no conventional cards
Composition/framing: a sparse top edge carries COLTON SPURGIN at left and WORK, RECORD, ABOUT, CONTACT at right; most of the viewport is one unbroken black hall with an enormous amber semicircle at the far wall doubled into a full sun by a mirrored ceiling. At the bottom, four small human silhouettes lie or sit along one horizon and are labeled AIR FORCE NCO, LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN, RESEARCH ASSISTANT, and AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026; each label reflects once above. Set the large line “USEFUL WORK. HARD PROBLEMS. NO THEATER.” low against the horizon in silhouette-black reverse. The lower edge begins SELECTED WORK as four numbered points: BORK, VELLM, TSP BENCHMARKS, HOME LAB. The sun and its reflection are the only dominant move; everything else is sparse and still.
Color palette: ink black #0b0906, sodium amber #df8d0b, deep amber #7f3d05, hot mirror light #e6b94b
Materials/textures: controlled mist haze, flat amber duotone, black silhouettes, mirrored reflection
Text (verbatim): “COLTON SPURGIN”; “WORK”; “RECORD”; “ABOUT”; “CONTACT”; “USEFUL WORK. HARD PROBLEMS. NO THEATER.”; “AIR FORCE NCO”; “LEAD SOFTWARE DEVELOPER INTERN”; “RESEARCH ASSISTANT”; “AI SPECIALIZATION · UWF · DEC 2026”; “SELECTED WORK”; “01 BORK”; “02 VELLM”; “03 TSP BENCHMARKS”; “04 HOME LAB”; “ENTER THE WORK”
Constraints: must read as a functional dark desktop website, not installation photography or a poster; preserve a clear nav and readable factual labels; no portrait, no logo, no invented metrics, employers, awards, testimonials, or project claims
Avoid: generic hero plus card grid, bento grid, beige editorial portfolio, cyberpunk neon, terminal UI, cockpit, military insignia, gradients outside the physical light haze, rounded cards, glassmorphism, 3D device mockup, browser chrome, illegible pseudo-text, watermark
